properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 27 at 11:29AM PDT until May 28 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.areaDesc: Riverside County Mountains; San Diego County Mountains; San Diego County Deserts; San Gorgonio Pass Near Banning
properties.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Riverside County Mountains, San Diego County Deserts, San
Diego County Mountains, and San Gorgonio Pass near Banning.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Locally
reduced visibility in blowing dust.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 27 at 11:16AM MST until May 28 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Southwest corner of Imperial County.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Difficult driving conditions, especially for larger
vehicles traveling along roads with crosswinds. Light,
unsecured objects may become airborne.
properties.instruction:
A Wind Advisory means that sustained wind speeds of between
30 and 40 mph are expected, or wind gusts of between 40 and
58 mph. Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially
for high profile vehicles.

In addition, strong winds over desert areas could result in
briefly lowered visibilities to well under a mile at times in
blowing dust or blowing sand. Use extra caution.

properties.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued May 27 at 10:52AM PDT until May 27 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Hanford CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...West winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* WHERE...Kern River Valley.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds and rough waves on area lakes will create
hazardous conditions for small craft.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 27 at 4:46AM PDT until May 28 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Western Mojave Desert.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
Pockets of blowing dust may impact motorists on Interstate 15,
Interstate 40, and Highway 58.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for
high-profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
